choice.world: A windward sailboat at a coastal regatta before an approaching summer squall
choice.scene: On a small racing sailboat in the golden hour with choppy harbor water and sail shadows
choice.shot: A candid mid-thigh angle aboard the racing dinghy, caught at a brief shift in wind
choice.shot_english: An unposed mid-thigh portrait framing her eyes, waist and taut working hands without widening for full gear.
choice.frame_intent: Her vivid eyes, natural shoulder line, functional fitted clothing and active rope gesture carry the story; hull and feet may crop.
choice.moment: A gust hits seconds before the regatta start, and she quickly corrects the mainsheet
choice.moment_english: hauling and resetting the mainsheet in a sudden wind shift before the starting signal
choice.emotion_tone: Windstruck concentration touched by a mischievous flicker of confidence as the race is about to begin.
choice.creative_intent: Show spontaneous natural feminine appeal in a moving lived-in sports scene, free of polished beauty posing.

camera_style.name: Salty sea breeze documentary editorial
camera_style.medium: Candid natural-light sailing editorial with authentic working movement
camera_style.optics: natural 50mm lens at f/2.8 with lifelike proportion and gently soft sea horizon
camera_style.lighting: uneven late afternoon sun skimming one cheek and wind-ruffled fabric
camera_style.palette: sea-glass teal, weathered ivory canvas, copper sun and deep water blue
camera_style.texture: fine documentary grain, real salt-damp skin and naturally creased linen
camera_style.framing: off-axis mid-thigh crop with sail and hull naturally extending outside frame

scene_design.subject: A clearly adult East Asian sailboat skipper taking control of a small racing boat just before a summer regatta.
scene_design.setting: On a wind-battered dinghy near the harbor start line; afternoon sun flashes off chop and pale canvas sails.
scene_design.action: As a gust snaps the sail she draws the mainsheet through a wet gloved hand, bracing her hip lightly against the cockpit rim.
scene_design.cue1: The red start-line flag whips in the background while the taut sail flashes above the cropped upper frame.
scene_design.cue2: A metal cleat and neatly coiled spare rope rest beside her; spray beads across the worn fiberglass deck.
scene_design.wardrobe: Sea-glass fitted sleeveless linen top, ivory high-waist sailing shorts, loose unbuttoned spray shirt, salt-tousled hair and thin scarf.
scene_design.composition: Windblown mid-thigh candid; sail, boat and legs naturally cropped.
scene_design.expression: She squints toward the sail with a crooked hint of delight, one windblown strand crossing her cheek as she exhales.
